verdict.rationale: CloudConvert documents both a sandbox API that runs unlimited jobs and tasks without consuming credits and a free tier of 10 conversions per day with no credit card required. A developer can therefore test real conversions before paying, and the Job Builder lets them try requests interactively. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documentation of any sandbox restrictions (e.g., which files or outputs are allowed).

support.subject: As a developer, a free tier, trial, or sandbox lets me test real conversions before paying

citations.quote: The sandbox API allows you to perform unlimited jobs and tasks without consuming your credits.
Start free with 10 conversions per day. No credit card required.
It allows you to generate and try out requests using a graphical interface.
